purpose: Opening six-panel storyboard concept sheet, preview only
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished six-panel cinematic storyboard concept sheet for the opening of a Chinese first-person narrative cocktail tavern game. It is a design board, not six final game assets. Layout: 2 columns x 3 rows, each panel a spacious 16:9 shot, narrow dark warm brown gutters, only tiny labels "01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06" at upper left of each panel. No other text. High-quality cohesive painterly 2D game concept art, detailed but legible gouache/digital illustration, natural wood grain and hand-drawn contours, warm amber island interiors with muted teal coastal exteriors, cool blue gray modern city. NOT pixel art, NOT low resolution, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D rendered, no exaggerated fantasy magic, no golden glitter. The existing game's style is a richly painted western saloon with substantial dark timber, brass lamps, textured wooden counter, real cocktail tools, warm atmospheric perspective; match this visual language while avoiding clutter. First-person protagonist never shown, no foreground hands.
Panel 01: present-day modern Chinese financial professional's modest apartment at night, first-person from a chair at a desk. Closed plain project folder, muted laptop with abstract unsuccessful project document and no readable text, old ceramic mug, one cardboard box near doorway; faint city through window. Quiet financial loss at age 35, not dramatic destruction, no piles of cash or falling stock charts.
Panel 02: years-earlier small modern city cocktail bar, first-person sitting opposite a refined middle-aged Chinese regular in a charcoal jacket with a moss-green pocket square, slight amused curiosity, not arrogant millionaire caricature. On counter TWO visibly different cocktails in matching stemmed coupe glasses: a pale green classic Last Word and a translucent pale straw-yellow mint-citrus riff. Near them a tiny open handwritten recipe notebook with illegible scribbles; ordinary bartender background silhouette. Warm restrained light, rainy modern city window, believable adults.
Panel 03: close first-person desk view in same apartment as 01, laptop showing a simple unlettered email layout with attached scanned recipe, a printed older recipe sheet with several crossed-out proportions and a small line drawing of a chair. Amber desk lamp now on, cool window outside. Invitation offers work at an island tavern; mood tentative curiosity, not instant happiness. No readable text, no logos.
Panel 04: arriving on an island dock, muted turquoise sea, a modest wooden passenger boat, rope and weathered timber, mist revealing low western maritime buildings. An elderly caretaker with gray beard in blue-gray work vest waits farther down dock with a small key ring. Calm dawn light, no palm resort, no pirate ship, no luxurious estate.
Panel 05: first-person at wooden island tavern threshold, camera focuses on a modest well-used EMPTY WOODEN CHAIR beside the door and an unlit brass wall lamp, a folded cleaning cloth on chair arm. Through doorway see the existing western saloon aesthetic: heavy timber, tables, dark wood, bar, practical lamps, subtle harbor influence. The caretaker stands offset beside doorway, not covering chair; same outfit as 04. Quiet emotional payoff, chair is ordinary not throne.
Panel 06: first-person cocktail workbench on that tavern's wood counter, warm but readable light. A brass jigger centrally left, open silver shaker centrally, serving stemmed coupe upper right, fresh textured mint and small bottles to right, ONE modest pale-gold outline around the jigger indicating the current tutorial step. Blank small parchment recipe note upper left, narrow understated pale parchment instruction strip at bottom, no text or giant arrows. A faint curved dotted path from gin bottle to jigger shows a drag interaction. Tools spaced and physically scaled, no hands, no magic glowing drink. Each panel has calm lower composition suitable for a later dialogue overlay. Consistent cinematic environmental storytelling with material detail and restrained color.
